{"ops": [{"insert": "18岁少年用产品导向增长和SEO做到32000美元MRR"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/8nbqKzfYAYzcGVjhRb4M/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/wilson-wilson-founder-of-senja.jpg"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 作者: Wilson Wilson (Senja创始人)", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 标签: 年轻创业者、产品导向增长、SEO、公开构建", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你12岁时在干嘛？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Wilson已经在网上赚到第一美元了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他缠着爸爸非要laptop，因为知道只要会coding就能build app、earn living。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有了之后，用StackOverflow借来的代码build和release了一打crappy apps。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用display ads变现。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那是entrepreneurship的第一口滋味，quickly learned这是他想做一辈子的事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但当时不知道怎么realistically把它变成career。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "17岁，ACL撕裂，手术，六周基本不能动。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那时候刚finish secondary school，刚做完freelance job，lots of time pondering what's next。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Start looking for people who had done what he wanted to do，stumbled upon Indie Hackers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "读Jon Yongfook、Tony Dinh、Danny Postmaa、Marie Martens等人的stories，showed him有indie business completely achievable。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不知道怎么做real business——只会code。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但new year coming up，wanted to start making something、anything by January。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他looked for what other people were building that he could build with his coding skills。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "几个basic ideas："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Blogging tool/website builder", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Social media scheduler", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Video hosting tool", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但最终settled on testimonial collection tool，因为那时候space里没多少players，而且大部分工具ugly且pain to use，他知道能do much better。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2022年1月2日开工，目标30天launch。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那产品就是Senja，让收集video和text testimonials easy的工具，同时帮用hundreds of different widgets、image templates、Walls of Love到处share。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SaaS模式，freemium。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Anyone can signup，first 15 text或video testimonials免费，可以create unlimited Walls of Love。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Collect unlimited testimonials、remove Senja branding、unlock其他features，客户付monthly或annual fee。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在20000 users，MRR 32000美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build MVP的时候还在recover from knee injury，所以unlimited time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also had few thousand saved up。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nearly zero costs。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nowadays build和launch SaaS for virtually nothing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch时唯一expenses是domain name和hosting，total 35美元/月。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有幸有parent's house safety可以work from，不用担心food、electricity、shelter等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很快开始有customers，他们cover了business expenses。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以再也没接freelance job！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在技术栈更复杂——testimonial collection里surprising amount needed。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Core用："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sveltekit：人们常问为什么Senja这么polished。Svelte是secret，有everything need，helped move incredibly fast。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "TailwindCSS styling", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Postgres + Hasura", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mux video storage和delivery", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Cloudflare CDN", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从crappy apps jump到successful SaaS需要几个东西："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Freelance jobs的经历helped improve technical skills。如果没spend all that time working for other people，不会build得这么快。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在X上share work huge。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和有过去business经验的co-founder collaborate，helped shift mindset从"builder"到business owner。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Consistency critical。六个月才有first recurring payment，但virtually every day都show up。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是没有challenges。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "来自尼日利亚Port Harcourt， beautiful city，但biggest disadvantage是being Nigerian。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lots of things other makers take for granted在这里不存在。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stripe、PayPal、Wise等popular tools and services不支持Nigerians。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Constantly put on high-risk list for everything（甚至shopping！）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Passport是全球least powerful之一，签证很难。Meetups和conferences largely off the table，从没见过co-founder in person。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stable internet connection rare，一天多次power cuts。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分城市coworking spaces不存在。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一开始take a lot of problems for granted，这些事情absolutely normal，没觉得need change。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但business grew、有更多money spend之后，开始look for workarounds。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Initially用Paddle（支持solo Nigerians）和Payoneer收payouts。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "买了power station应对outages，保证有internet和lights。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "买了5G router、eventually Starlink，不会lose days to bad internet。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "自建了office。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Overall，so much want to do but can't yet because of where born。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Definitely difficult to work around，但today endless opportunities available to anyone willing to put in work，regardless of where come from。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "增长策略："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一开始throw a lot of spaghetti at wall see what stuck。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Built in public", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Wrote blog posts", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Regularly posted on Indie Hackers、Reddit、Facebook、LinkedIn、Quora", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Listed on directories like Betalist、Startups.fyi、uneed.best、SaaSHUB、GrowthStash.co", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Joined founder和creator communities in slack和discord", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sponsored dozens of newsletters", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "甚至试了cold outreach via email和Reddit", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Each helped a bit，但none比得上beginning时的building in public。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来best channels变成SEO和product-led growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Building in Public", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Start building Senja with zero followers、no audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Literally brand new X account。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但build时share daily progress updates和launch plans，helped slowly build audience支持他launch！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Now over 20000 followers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Daily"是key。如果给one tip怎么grow X account，就是consistency。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Greatest benefit to building in public是definitely community you become surrounded by。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tapped into knowledge of hundreds of founders who were where he wanted to be。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Everything he knows来自build-in-public community——加上读Indie Hackers和Indie Bites stories。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also got loads of feedback helped improve product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Found mentors、lifelong friends、co-founder。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " painstaking，因为very very small percentage of people reached是ideal customers——unless selling to other Indie Hackers，building in public不是sustainable或scaleable way找new customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但从BIP signup的人是invested in journey as founders的人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Focus on SEO", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在45% traffic from SEO。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Rank top 3 for testimonial related keywords like "testimonial collection tool"和"collect testimonials"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "To get there，written dozens of blog posts，created pages target比如"video testimonials"、"testimonial collection software"等high volume、little competition的keywords。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also created pages targeting competitors的alternative keywords。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Created hundreds of pages for programmatic SEO target hundreds of long tail keywords。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Alternative pages是highest converting SEO pages，因为来自那里的人already looking for a way out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Programmatic只spent few days doing，但getting good number of signups from few hundred pages already，currently SEO effort giving greatest reward for effort done。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product-led growth和freemium", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Kick in花了long time，但现在product-led growth负责约30% Senja growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product itself drives user acquisition、retention、expansion。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Senja有most generous free tier of any testimonial tool on market。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Free users是best promoters！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Powered-by badges显示在free users的testimonials上，tens of thousands of times每个月seen，hundreds of people signup each month。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If wasn't for this product-led growth和these badges，never have gone freemium。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Rob Walling总结得好："If your freemium users aren't at some level helping push growth of your paid tiers，offering freemium plan isn't right call。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Affiliates和influencers", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Affiliates负责16% new signups。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Co-founder painstakingly reached out to dozens（maybe hundreds now）influencers，like Jay Clouse、Kieran Drew、Easlo。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Spent insane amount of time building relationships、giving genuinely helpful advice。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Thanks to his efforts，Senja now most popular testimonial collection tool among creators！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很多creators signup affiliate program，regularly include in newsletters、courses、blog posts。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also incentivize affiliates keep powered-by badge——even after upgrading——allowing update badge with affiliate link。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Affiliates get 30% revenue they bring in。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Newsletter sponsorships", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Some success from few newsletters，但compared to other channels，ROI not that high。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Historically greatest ROI when sponsor customers already using Senja in marketing funnels。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "They know product really well因为use daily，so they sell it best！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给创始人的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不喜欢build portfolio of small bets的想法，think that's common pitfall。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Too many indie makers launch dozen products without giving any attention they need to grow。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Couple months里launch dozen products容易；stick to one product、learn to grow it、build business around it难得多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Working through challenges是where real growth happens。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Building product ≠ building business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If your product isn't instant hit，doesn't make it failure。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Chances are，if spend sizable amount of time improving product、talking to potential customers、experimenting with different marketing strategies，things will start to compound。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文链接:", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " https://www.indiehackers.com/post/8nbqKzfYAYzcGVjhRb4M"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

content_en:
18-Year-Old Achieved $32K MRR with Product-Led Growth and SEO

What were you doing at age 12?

Wilson had already earned his first dollar online.

He pestered his dad until he got a laptop, because he knew that as long as he could code, he could build apps and earn a living.

After getting it, he used code borrowed from StackOverflow to build and release a dozen crappy apps.

He monetized with display ads.

That was the first taste of entrepreneurship, and he quickly learned this was something he wanted to do for life.

But at the time, he didn't know how to realistically turn it into a career.

At 17, he tore his ACL, had surgery, couldn't move for six weeks.

At that time, he had just finished secondary school, had just finished a freelance job, lots of time pondering what's next.

Started looking for people who had done what he wanted to do.
content_jp:
18歳、产品主导增长とSEOで32,000ドルMRRを達成

あなたは12歳の時何していましたか？

Wilsonはオンラインで既に最初の1ドルを稼いでいました。

彼はラップトップを#getするまで父親にせがんでいた%、 لأنه كان يعرف أنه طالما يستطيع البرمجة، يمكنه بناء التطبيقات وكسب لقمة العيش.

それ到手后%、彼はStackOverflowから借りたコードを使って множество のくだらないアプリを構築·リリースした。

彼はディスプレイ广告で収益化した。

それが起業の最初の味で%、素早くこれが一辈子にしたいことだと学んだ。

でもその时%、それを现实的にキャリアにする方法を知らなかった。

17歳でACLを断裂し、手術、六周间动けなかった。

その时こそ%、彼はちょうど中等学校を終了したところで%、フリーランスの仕事を完了したところで%、次に何をする哉有很多时间考えるだった。

彼はやりたいと思っていたことを既にやった人を 찾め始めた。
content_ar:
дости عائدات شهرية قدرها 32 ألف دولار في سن 18 من خلال النمو بقيادة المنتج وتحسين محركات البحث

ماذا كنت تفعل في سن 12؟

ويلسون уже заработал свой первый доллар онлайн.

Он досаждал отцу, пока не получил ноутбук, потому что знал, что если умеет программировать, может создавать приложения и зарабатывать на жизнь.

Получив его, он использовал код, позаимствованный от StackOverflow, чтобы создать и выпустить кучу паршивых приложений.

Он монетизировал с помощью медийной рекламы.

Это был первый вкус предпринимательства, и он быстро понял, что это то, чем он хочет заниматься всю жизнь.

Но в то время он не знал, как реалистично превратить это в карьеру.

В 17 лет он разорвал ACL, перенес операцию, не мог двигаться шесть недель.

В это время он только что закончил среднюю школу, только что закончил фриланс-работу, было много времени размышлять о том, что дальше.

Начал искать людей, которые сделали то, что он хотел сделать.
